description: Heap.js 5 configuration loader on cdn.us.heap-api.com and cdn.eu.heap-api.com, whose environment ID rides in the path as /config/{envId}/heap_config.js. Classic heap-{id}.js on cdn.heapanalytics.com is not contracted.

params.name: env_id
params.description: It is the Heap environment ID (app ID). Heap documents the loader as `cdn.us.heap-api.com/config/{YOUR_APP_ID}/heap_config.js`.
params.fix_hint: Copy the snippet from Heap Projects so the path is `/config/{envId}/heap_config.js`.
